title: The Mirror Parlor and Ancestral Gallery
authorship: Original procedural Blender furniture, architectural details, materials, relief portraits and working compositions created for Gomstalle
parlor: Fitted marble and plaster hearth with grate and logs
Curved tufted velvet settees with turned legs, silk cushions and brass inlays
Oval conversation table with porcelain tea service and pastries
Chess table with an unfinished game and score sheet
Correspondence desk with sealed letters, ink and quill
gallery: Original knight and skeleton paintings in individually proportioned carved frames
Original sculpted founder, rose warden and astronomer relief medallions
Fluted display pilasters with capitals and shallow pediments
Low cushioned viewing benches and compass floor inlays
Curator flat-file cabinet, open provenance ledger, restoration brushes, magnifier, canvas rolls and stored frames
circulation: Explicit station-body collision proxies preserve all real door approaches, the shrine at (5, 23), the gallery south turn and loops around the parlor tea service
source_art_license: Preserved portraits were rendered from existing KayKit CC0 characters; the mirror is an original Gomstalle model. See ../sources.json and ../KayKit-License.txt.
